notes.title: Patch 05172024
notes.content:
Patch 05172024
- Added map system. Press [M] to show map.
- Added compass system.
- Player's hunger and thirst rate 2x slower.
- Added non-flying ridable horse in the wood house for player's early mobility.
- Vaelora's Chest wallet of gold coins are now respawnable in 2 seconds once taken, avoiding the issue that players can't complete quest due to lost of items.
- Reduced the dodge roll energy consumption by 40%.
- Cooked Meat will have 10x slower decay time; Cooked Meat now restores 70% hunger instead of 14%, previously it was same as corns.
- Improved issues in the enemy pop in and out in castle ruins at the bottom of knight statue.

notes.title: This new soulslike sandbox survival sim has just launched on Steam
notes.content:
The joy of gaming is seeing new ideas crop up in unexpected ways. Genres get smushed together to make something new. Things spark off each other and come up with something greater than the sum of their parts. That's definitely the case in Kingdom of Fallen: The Last Stand, a brand new survival sim with soulslike combat that's just launched on Steam.

notes.title: Slip some survival into your soulslike in this new, grim RPG
notes.content:
One of the best things about the Dark Souls games, and of course Elden Ring, becoming smash hits is seeing new takes on the formula, developers mashing together genres or adding their own unique twists on what being a soulslike means. In Kingdom of Fallen: The Last Stand the unique idea is to mix together the challenge, dark worldbuilding, and combat from a soulslike with the open-world crafting of a survival game like Sons of the Forest.
